limits: Programme membership is not recorded on this server, so how many people are enrolled in a programme is not counted: only what was handed over under it. A programme with nothing handed over may still have members.

disclosure.basis: Every count is shown as its real number, however small: the MSWDO decided on 24 November 2026 not to withhold small counts. A count of one or two in a barangay can identify the person behind it, so handle these figures as personal information under RA 10173.
